learning_outcomes.text: Students know mathematical constructs and concepts such as vectors, matrices, determinants, and systems of linear equations.
They can safely apply the mathematical methods of vector and matrix calculus.
assess the solvability of linear equation systems.
solve systems of linear equations by applying different methods.
Students are familiar with handling elementary functions that depend on one variable.
and can analyze them with the methods of differential and integral calculus.
They also master handling complex numbers.

syllabus_topics: Differential calculus (Elementary functions, limits, continuity, differentiability, derivative rules, applications, extremum problems)
Integral calculus (Antiderivative, area calculation, mean value theorem, substitution, partial fraction decomposition, applications)
Complex numbers (Arithmetic, Gaussian number plane, powers, roots, logarithms, Euler's equation, fundamental theorem of algebra)
assessment_rules: Homework is a prerequisite (Prüfungsvorleistung XP) for the written examination. The final grade is based on the written examination.
bibliography: Dürrschnabel, K. – Mathematik für Ingenieure - Eine Einführung mit Anwendungs- und Alltagsbeispielen. Springer-Vieweg, 2. Auflage, 2012.
